Ingredients:

- 1 sheet of puff pastry
- 1/2 cup of black olives, pitted and finely chopped
- 1/2 cup of green olives, pitted and finely chopped
- 1/2 cup of feta cheese, crumbled
- 1/2 cup of grated Parmesan cheese
- 1/4 cup of fresh basil leaves, finely chopped
- 1 egg, beaten
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:

1. Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

2. Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface into a rectangle shape.

3. In a bowl, combine the chopped black and green olives, crumbled feta cheese, grated Parmesan cheese, and chopped basil leaves. Mix well until all ingredients are evenly distributed.

4. Spread the olive and cheese mixture evenly over the puff pastry, leaving a small border around the edges. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

5. Starting from one of the shorter ends, roll the puff pastry tightly into a log. 

6. Using a sharp knife, cut the log into slices approximately 1/2 inch thick.

7. Place the slices on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 1 inch apart.

8. Brush the tops of the spirals with the beaten egg to give them a nice golden color when baked.

9. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the spirals are puffed and golden brown.

10. Allow the spirals to cool slightly on the baking sheet before serving.

Enjoy these delicious Olive Spirals as a snack, appetizer, or side dish! They are best served warm.
